description: This file defines a wizard interface for managing journal entries in an accounting module, including form layout, data retrieval, and window actions.

classes.name: wiz_journal
classes.description: Wizard interface class for journal management with states for initialization and opening journal window.

methods.name: _period_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current accounting period ID.

methods.name: _action_open_window
methods.description: Prepares and returns an action to open the journal entries window based on selected journal and period.
